handover_report.title: EverythingAI — Phase 8.2 Green CI Baseline Handover
handover_report.prepared_for: Next AI engineering agent / continuation session

repository.name: everythingAI
repository.branch_policy: Work directly on main unless the user explicitly changes this rule. CI now validates pushes to main and pull requests to main.

executive_summary.project_identity: EverythingAI is a validated local-first, source-backed AI knowledge workspace with a Client Workspace, Admin Dashboard, durable Knowledge Base/Wiki layer, governed planning/execution/undo, admin-selected AI providers, admin-only Agent Connectors, and a green GitHub CI smoke pipeline.
executive_summary.current_phase: Phase 8.2 Green CI Baseline complete. Ready for Phase 8.3 connector-specific setup and release hardening.
executive_summary.latest_milestone: GitHub Actions CI smoke workflow is implemented and green across backend tests, frontend typecheck/build, and Playwright Client/Admin smoke tests.
executive_summary.important_note: Phase 8.2 was initially documented before the CI workflow was fully verified. That inconsistency has been resolved. The workflow now exists, runs, and has passed.

playwright_smoke.command: cd apps/everything-ai-ui && npx playwright test smoke/client-admin-smoke.spec.ts

playwright_job.important_fix: Backend readiness accepts HTTP 200 or HTTP 401 from /api/status because /api/status is authenticated and 401 proves the backend is alive.

roadmap_state.next_recommended_phase: Phase 8.3 — Connector-Specific Setup, Release Hardening, and Production-Readiness Cleanup
phase_8_3_required_next: Controlled connector-specific setup/testing for Claude Code
Keep OpenCode, Kilo Code, and Cline documented as not installed / not on PATH until installed
Continue frontend modularization and cleanup of legacy admin paths
Improve API key lifecycle UX: saved / replace / clear
Improve rich citation/source highlighting and extracted document formatting
Update release checklist after Phase 8.3 work

critical_architecture_rules: Client Workspace can chat with AI only through the backend/admin-selected active provider.
Client Workspace must not expose provider selection, API keys, remote-provider policy, planning policy, or agent connector configuration.
Admin Dashboard owns provider settings, API keys, remote-provider policy, planning rules, and Agent Connectors.
Agent bridge execution remains disabled by default.
Agent chat execution remains disabled by default.
Do not enable arbitrary shell command execution from the browser.
Do not expose Agent Connectors in Client Workspace.
Do not change human-validation governance rules.
Do not remove existing diagnostics or validation artifacts.
Do not weaken evidence/source provenance rules.

ci: Push to main or open PR to main
Verify EverythingAI CI Smoke passes all jobs in GitHub Actions

recommended_next_session_plan.step_0: Read the Green CI handover and documentation audit. Run git status and git pull origin main. Confirm working tree is clean.
recommended_next_session_plan.step_1: Review Phase 8.3 requirements in docs/ROADMAP.md and docs/IMPLEMENTATION_ROADMAP.md.
recommended_next_session_plan.step_2: Start Phase 8.3A: controlled Codex connector-specific setup/testing without enabling arbitrary browser command execution or default chat execution.
recommended_next_session_plan.step_3: Continue Phase 8.3A: controlled Claude Code connector-specific setup/testing under the same safety constraints.
recommended_next_session_plan.step_4: If all validations stay green, proceed to Admin connector diagnostics UX polish and connector health visibility.
recommended_next_session_plan.step_5: Run backend tests, frontend typecheck/build, Playwright smoke tests, and verify GitHub CI is green.
recommended_next_session_plan.step_6: Create validation artifact and handover at the next milestone boundary.

known_risks_and_followups: Branch protection is not yet enforced. CI validates pushes but does not block direct pushes to main unless GitHub branch protection is configured later.

GitHub Actions displayed a warning about Node.js 20 action runtime deprecation for actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, and actions/upload-artifact@v4. This is not currently blocking but should be tracked as maintenance.
Frontend dependency audit still reports high-severity warnings from npm audit. Do not run npm audit fix --force without review because it may introduce breaking changes.
Production readiness remains 30-40%; authentication, users, tenants, secure credential storage, and production infrastructure are still later roadmap items.
Agent chat must not be enabled until connector-specific setup, security review, and explicit user approval are complete.
handover_report.final_status: EverythingAI Phase 8.2 Green CI Baseline is complete. The next session should begin Phase 8.3A connector-specific hardening from this handover.
